gh_bw1.title: Blade Work
gh_bw1.description: +0.3 Attack Speed. You've honed your dagger technique on a thousand shambling targets.

gh_bw2a.title: Twin Fangs
gh_bw2a.description: +0.5 Attack Speed. Two blades, two cuts, one heartbeat. Dual wielding perfected through apocalypse.

gh_bw2b.title: Serrated Edge
gh_bw2b.description: +0.2 Attack Speed, +2 Attack Damage. A jagged blade that tears on the way out. Maximum damage per cut.

gh_bw3aa.title: Scissor Strike
gh_bw3aa.description: +0.8 Attack Speed. Blades cross and uncross in a blur. Heads separate from shoulders before bodies fall.

gh_bw3ab.title: Viper Flurry
gh_bw3ab.description: +0.6 Attack Speed, +1 Attack Damage. Fast as a snake's tongue  -  each strike venomous and precise.

gh_bw3ba.title: Hemorrhage
gh_bw3ba.description: +3 Attack Damage. One deep cut in the right place. The infected don't bleed out but they sure fall apart.

gh_bw3bb.title: Death of a Thousand Cuts
gh_bw3bb.description: +2 Attack Damage, +0.4 Attack Speed. Fast, sharp, relentless. They decompose faster than they regenerate.

gh_cap1.title: Wraith Initiate
gh_cap1.description: +1 Attack Damage, +0.2 Attack Speed. You've begun the transformation. More spirit than flesh, more death than life.

gh_cap2a.title: Spectral Fury
gh_cap2a.description: +2 Attack Damage, +0.3 Attack Speed. Strike with the rage of the unquiet dead. Fast, vicious, relentless.

gh_cap2b.title: Ethereal Form
gh_cap2b.description: +4 Max Health, +0.008 Movement Speed. Your body phases between states. Hard to hit what's barely corporeal.

gh_cap3aa.title: Wraith Lord
gh_cap3aa.description: +3 Attack Damage, +0.5 Attack Speed. The ultimate ghost  -  all speed, all lethality, no mercy. A king of shadows.

gh_cap3ab.title: Doom Blade
gh_cap3ab.description: +4 Attack Damage, +0.2 Attack Speed. Your weapon pulses with killing intent. Each swing reaps like a scythe through wheat.

gh_cap3ba.title: Specter's Endurance
gh_cap3ba.description: +6 Max Health, +0.01 Movement Speed. An undying wraith. Fast, resilient, eternal. The apocalypse made flesh.

gh_cap3bb.title: Ascended Wraith
gh_cap3bb.description: +2 Attack Damage, +4 Max Health, +0.15 Knockback Resistance. Transcended mortality entirely. A god of shadow and silence.

gh_ev1.title: Evasion
gh_ev1.description: +0.01 Movement Speed. Dodge, duck, weave. You flow around attacks like water around stone.

gh_ev2a.title: Slip Away
gh_ev2a.description: +0.015 Movement Speed. Grabbing hands close on empty air. You were there a moment ago  -  now you're not.

gh_ev2b.title: Deflect
gh_ev2b.description: +0.008 Movement Speed, +0.1 Knockback Resistance. Redirect force rather than absorb it. An aikido of the apocalypse.

gh_ev3aa.title: Untouchable
gh_ev3aa.description: +0.02 Movement Speed. They swing, you're gone. A phantom that exists between moments of violence.

gh_ev3ab.title: Ghost Step
gh_ev3ab.description: +0.012 Movement Speed, +2 Max Health. Move like you're already dead  -  weightless, formless, unkillable.

gh_ev3ba.title: Iron Mist
gh_ev3ba.description: +0.15 Knockback Resistance. You absorb impacts like fog absorbs light  -  present but immovable.

gh_ev3bb.title: Phase Shift
gh_ev3bb.description: +0.1 Knockback Resistance, +0.01 Movement Speed. Exist partially in another place. Hits pass through you like you're not quite real.

gh_lf1.title: Lightfoot
gh_lf1.description: +0.01 Movement Speed. Your footfalls are whispers. You cross rubble fields without disturbing a single pebble.

gh_lf2a.title: Cat's Grace
gh_lf2a.description: +0.015 Movement Speed. Land from any height without sound. Move through any space without trace.

gh_lf2b.title: Silent Approach
gh_lf2b.description: +0.008 Movement Speed, +2 Attack Damage. Get close without being detected. The first hit is always free.

gh_lf3aa.title: Featherweight
gh_lf3aa.description: +0.02 Movement Speed. You weigh nothing. Snow doesn't crunch, leaves don't rustle, floorboards don't creak.

gh_lf3ab.title: Shadow Walker
gh_lf3ab.description: +0.012 Movement Speed, +2 Max Health. Walk between worlds  -  half in shadow, half in flesh. Barely there but very much alive.

gh_lf3ba.title: Backstab
gh_lf3ba.description: +3 Attack Damage. Approach unseen, strike unblocked. The perfect kill  -  clean, quiet, efficient.

gh_lf3bb.title: Shadow Assassin
gh_lf3bb.description: +2 Attack Damage, +0.01 Movement Speed. Silent death walking. You were never here  -  only the bodies prove otherwise.

gh_ph1.title: Predator Hunt
gh_ph1.description: +1 Attack Damage, +0.005 Movement Speed. You stalk the dead like prey. The hunter becomes the apex.

gh_ph2a.title: Stalker's Patience
gh_ph2a.description: +2 Attack Damage. Wait for the perfect moment. One strike, one kill, zero wasted effort.

gh_ph2b.title: Chase Down
gh_ph2b.description: +0.015 Movement Speed. Once you lock on, nothing escapes. You run prey to ground like a wolf.

gh_ph3aa.title: Assassin's Mark
gh_ph3aa.description: +3 Attack Damage. You see weak points others miss  -  joints, fractures, exposed vertebrae. Every hit is critical.

gh_ph3ab.title: Kill Confirmed
gh_ph3ab.description: +2 Attack Damage, +2 Max Health. Each kill validates your method. Stronger, more confident, more lethal.

gh_ph3ba.title: Sprint Killer
gh_ph3ba.description: +0.02 Movement Speed. Close the gap in a heartbeat. They hear footsteps and then nothing else  -  ever.

gh_ph3bb.title: Apex Phantom
gh_ph3bb.description: +2 Attack Damage, +0.01 Movement Speed. Top of the shadow food chain. Nothing outruns or outlasts you.

gh_sk1.title: Silent Kill
gh_sk1.description: +2 Attack Damage. One strike from the shadows. They never hear you, never see you, never rise again.

gh_sk2a.title: Throat Cutter
gh_sk2a.description: +3 Attack Damage. Aim for the spine. Even the undead need a nervous system  -  sever it.

gh_sk2b.title: Ambush Predator
gh_sk2b.description: +1 Attack Damage, +0.3 Attack Speed. Patience, then explosion. You strike like a coiled spring releasing.

gh_sk3aa.title: Decapitator
gh_sk3aa.description: +4 Attack Damage. One perfect arc. The head tumbles before the body knows it's dead  -  again.

gh_sk3ab.title: Vital Strike
gh_sk3ab.description: +3 Attack Damage, +0.005 Movement Speed. Target the critical point, close the distance instantly, end it.

gh_sk3ba.title: Rapid Execution
gh_sk3ba.description: +0.5 Attack Speed. Kill, move, kill, move. A rhythm of silent death that clears rooms in seconds.

gh_sk3bb.title: Reaper's Tempo
gh_sk3bb.description: +2 Attack Damage, +0.3 Attack Speed. Death has a rhythm and you've mastered its beat. Swing, kill, repeat.

gh_sm1.title: Smoke Screen
gh_sm1.description: +0.1 Knockback Resistance. Vanish into the haze. When they can't see you, they can't touch you.

gh_sm2a.title: Fog of War
gh_sm2a.description: +0.15 Knockback Resistance. You move within a personal shroud. The dead grasp blindly and find nothing.

gh_sm2b.title: Choking Cloud
gh_sm2b.description: +0.1 Knockback Resistance, +1 Attack Damage. Strike from within the haze. They choke while you cut.

gh_sm3aa.title: Total Concealment
gh_sm3aa.description: +0.2 Knockback Resistance. Invisible to all senses. You're a void in their perception  -  untargetable.

gh_sm3ab.title: Smoke Dancer
gh_sm3ab.description: +0.15 Knockback Resistance, +0.01 Movement Speed. Dance through the smoke trail you leave behind. Graceful annihilation.

gh_sm3ba.title: Poison Fog
gh_sm3ba.description: +2 Attack Damage. Your smoke carries death. Breathe it in, fall down, stay down.

gh_sm3bb.title: Noxious Shroud
gh_sm3bb.description: +2 Attack Damage, +0.1 Knockback Resistance. A walking cloud of lethality. Everything near you wilts and dies.

gh_ss1.title: Shadow Sprint
gh_ss1.description: +0.015 Movement Speed. You learned to run in silence  -  bare feet on broken glass without a sound.

gh_ss2a.title: Midnight Dash
gh_ss2a.description: +0.02 Movement Speed. Darkness is your highway. You blur between shadows like smoke on the wind.

gh_ss2b.title: Quicksilver Step
gh_ss2b.description: +0.01 Movement Speed, +0.3 Attack Speed. Fast feet feed fast hands. Strike before they know you're there.

gh_ss3aa.title: Phantom Velocity
gh_ss3aa.description: +0.025 Movement Speed. You move so fast the infected can't track you. A ghost on the wind.

gh_ss3ab.title: Blur
gh_ss3ab.description: +0.018 Movement Speed, +2 Max Health. Speed is survival. You outrun death itself, and it keeps you alive.

gh_ss3ba.title: Razor Wind
gh_ss3ba.description: +0.5 Attack Speed. Your blade moves with your momentum  -  a cutting gale that shreds the dead.

gh_ss3bb.title: Speed Demon
gh_ss3bb.description: +0.015 Movement Speed, +0.4 Attack Speed. Velocity incarnate. Every step is a strike, every stride a kill.

gh_sv1.title: Survivability
gh_sv1.description: +2 Max Health. You've survived longer than most. Scar tissue and instinct keep you breathing.

gh_sv2a.title: Cockroach Tenacity
gh_sv2a.description: +4 Max Health. Can't squash what refuses to die. You keep crawling back no matter what.

gh_sv2b.title: Shadow Armor
gh_sv2b.description: +2 Max Health, +0.1 Knockback Resistance. Darkness wraps around you like a second skin. It absorbs what you can't dodge.

gh_sv3aa.title: Nine Lives
gh_sv3aa.description: +6 Max Health. You've cheated death so many times it feels personal. Ninth time's the charm.

gh_sv3ab.title: Resilient Shadow
gh_sv3ab.description: +4 Max Health, +0.005 Movement Speed. Tough enough to take a hit, fast enough to not take a second.

gh_sv3ba.title: Unyielding Phantom
gh_sv3ba.description: +0.15 Knockback Resistance. Anchored in shadow. Blows pass through your form without displacing you.

gh_sv3bb.title: Deathless
gh_sv3bb.description: +3 Max Health, +0.1 Knockback Resistance. Beyond mortal fragility. You exist in the space between alive and not.

gh_ws1.title: Wind Step
gh_ws1.description: +0.012 Movement Speed. Each step carries you further than physics allows. The wind is your ally.

gh_ws2a.title: Gale Runner
gh_ws2a.description: +0.018 Movement Speed. Carried by currents the dead can't feel. You surf the apocalypse winds.

gh_ws2b.title: Tailwind Strike
gh_ws2b.description: +0.008 Movement Speed, +1 Attack Damage. The wind at your back adds force to every swing.

gh_ws3aa.title: Tempest Walker
gh_ws3aa.description: +0.022 Movement Speed. You ARE the storm  -  chaotic, swift, impossible to predict or catch.

gh_ws3ab.title: Zephyr Blade
gh_ws3ab.description: +0.012 Movement Speed, +2 Attack Damage. Wind-guided strikes that find gaps in bone and sinew.

gh_ws3ba.title: Hurricane Force
gh_ws3ba.description: +2 Attack Damage. Your strikes carry the weight of a gale. Rotting limbs scatter like leaves.

gh_ws3bb.title: Cyclone
gh_ws3bb.description: +1 Attack Damage, +0.015 Movement Speed. A spinning vortex of blade and motion. Enter the eye and find only death.
